mapper.select: SELECT frame_sn FROM bike_vehicle WHERE vehicle_qr_code=#{qrCode} OR vehicle_qr_token=#{qrCode}
SELECT frame_sn FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding WHERE part_sn=#{partSn} ORDER BY is_current DESC,bind_time DESC LIMIT 1
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding pb WHERE pb.vehicle_id=v.id AND pb.part_sn=#{partSn}) GROUP BY v.id ORDER BY v.updated_at DESC

SELECT 'BINDING' type,CASE WHEN b.is_current=1 THEN '绑定' ELSE '解绑' END action,b.part_type,b.part_sn,COALESCE(CASE WHEN b.is_current=1 THEN bu.display_name ELSE uu.display_name END,bu.display_name,uu.display_name) operator_name,COALESCE(b.unbind_reason,b.bind_reason) reason,COALESCE(b.unbind_time,b.bind_time) operation_time FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding b LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user bu ON bu.id=b.bind_operator_id LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user uu ON uu.id=b.unbind_operator_id WHERE b.frame_sn=#{frameSn} ORDER BY b.bind_time

SELECT business_type type,action,COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(before_data,'$.partType')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(after_data,'$.partType'))) part_type,COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(before_data,'$.partSn')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(after_data,'$.partSn'))) part_sn,operator_name,remark reason,operation_time FROM bike_operation_log log WHERE frame_sn=#{frameSn} OR (business_type='PRODUCTION' AND ( business_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT p.task_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM bike_production_vehicle p JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=p.vehicle_id WHERE v.frame_sn=#{frameSn}) OR business_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT p.id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM bike_production_print p JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=p.vehicle_id WHERE v.frame_sn=#{frameSn}) OR business_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci IN (SELECT i.id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM bike_production_issue i WHERE i.code=#{frameSn} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding b WHERE b.frame_sn=#{frameSn} AND b.part_sn COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci=i.code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)) )) ORDER BY operation_time

SELECT si.stock_in_no stock_in_no, w.warehouse_name, l.location_name, si.status, si.operation_time, si.cancel_reason FROM bike_stock_in_record si JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=si.vehicle_id JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id=si.warehouse_id JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id=si.location_id WHERE v.frame_sn=#{frameSn} ORDER BY si.operation_time

SELECT so.stock_out_no stock_out_no, c.customer_name, o.order_no, so.status, so.operation_time, so.cancel_reason FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=so.vehicle_id JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=so.customer_id JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=so.order_id WHERE v.frame_sn=#{frameSn} ORDER BY so.operation_time

SELECT r.rework_no, d.part_type, d.old_part_sn, d.new_part_sn, r.reason, r.status, COALESCE(u.display_name, '-') operator_name, r.operation_time FROM bike_rework_record r LEFT JOIN bike_rework_part_detail d ON d.rework_id=r.id LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id=r.operator_id WHERE r.frame_sn=#{frameSn} ORDER BY r.operation_time

SELECT DISTINCT si.stock_in_no stock_in_no, w.warehouse_name, l.location_name, si.status, si.operation_time, si.cancel_reason FROM bike_stock_in_record si JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=si.vehicle_id JOIN bike_vehicle_part_binding b ON b.vehicle_id=v.id AND b.part_sn=#{partSn} JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id=si.warehouse_id JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id=si.location_id ORDER BY si.operation_time

SELECT DISTINCT so.stock_out_no stock_out_no, c.customer_name, o.order_no, so.status, so.operation_time, so.cancel_reason FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=so.vehicle_id JOIN bike_vehicle_part_binding b ON b.vehicle_id=v.id AND b.part_sn=#{partSn} JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=so.customer_id JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=so.order_id ORDER BY so.operation_time

SELECT r.rework_no, d.part_type, d.old_part_sn, d.new_part_sn, r.reason, r.status, COALESCE(u.display_name, '-') operator_name, r.operation_time FROM bike_rework_record r JOIN bike_rework_part_detail d ON d.rework_id=r.id LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id=r.operator_id WHERE d.old_part_sn=#{partSn} OR d.new_part_sn=#{partSn} ORDER BY r.operation_time
